paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Simon: Bava Kamma 47b.
Rabbi Yusti son of Rabbi Simon: Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin, chapter 6, halakhah 4.
Rabbi Yose son of Rabbi Simon: Jerusalem Talmud Maaser Sheni, chapter 4, halakhah 2. Levi bar Simon: Chullin 141b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital Bava Kamma 47b paragraph fully writes Rav Yehudah bar Simon, supporting Rav in the first notice. The remaining three names and their distinct locators are not merged with that person.

The checked witnesses name Rav Yehudah bar Simon in Bava Kamma 47b, Rabbi Yusti beRabbi Simon in Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 6:4, Rabbi Yose beRabbi Simon in Maaser Sheni 4:2, and Levi bar Simon in Chullin 141b. The collection records distinct attestations; it does not make their fathers one person.
